── MARISOL'S WEEK ──
Marisol is training for a second marathon, the Wexley Lakes Marathon, aiming to break 3:45 after a 4:02 debut. Marisol runs five days a week, with a session on Wednesday, the long run on Sunday and Monday and Friday off, and ran about 30 miles a week before this build.
Recent weeks: 30, 32, 35 mi
This week: 32 mi over 5 runs. Planned 36 mi, ran 32 mi.
Pain noted: Thu 2/10 (Outside of right knee tight on the last hill); Sat 1/10 (Knee a little tight before the run, fine during); Sun 4/10 (Outside of right knee, sharp on downhills from mile 7. Walked the last half mile.)
Body: "Right knee aches going down stairs today. Never had this before."
Feeling: "Worried about the knee."
Asks: "Is this an IT band thing? Should I still do Wednesday's tempo?"

── THE DRAFT ──
Tells Marisol: The right knee comes first this week, so skip Wednesday's tempo, cap the long run, and get it looked at by a physio before we…
Answers: (1) I can't tell you what it is, and I would not guess. Lateral knee pain that bites on downhills and lingers on stairs is worth a visit to a sports physio this week so you get a real answer rather than a label from me. (2) No on Wednesday's tempo. Threshold pace plus hills plus a sore knee is the fastest way to turn a niggle into weeks off.
Safety flag: See a sports physio about the right knee
Next week:
Mon: rest. Book a physio appointment this week if you can.
Tue: easy, 4 mi, flat route, heart rate under 140, stop if the knee bites. A gentle test…
Wed: other, 45 min easy spin on a bike or pool run, no running. Keeps the aerobic work…
Thu: easy, 4 mi, flat, heart rate under 140. Only if Tuesday was pain-free during and…
Fri: rest. Full day off, same as always.
Sat: easy, 3 mi, flat and relaxed. Short shakeout before Sunday.
Sun: long, 8 mi, flat loop, heart rate under 145, walk home at the first sign of sharp…
